ruling.headline: Outside event: duplicate Visa settlements, April 11–12, 2025
ruling.detail: wgeld.org documents duplicate Visa charges on InvoiceCloud payments in this window. All 4 extra postings (Maya Chen, Sam Rivera, Alex Morgan, Jordan Ellis) fall inside it, at 4 different merchants. This is a processing error, not employee error. No one needs to be contacted.
ruling.quote: “ InvoiceCloud has received communication from Chase Paymentech that Visa has confirmed that they experienced an issue on their end over the weekend. This issue resulted in issuers duplicating charges to their cardholders. The problem began on Friday and affected settlements until 9 AM ET on Sunday, at which point Visa reverted the change on their end.

ruling.headline: Shared cause: the tip is added after the card is authorized (Toast)
ruling.detail: support.toasttab.com explains that the final card charge includes the tip added after authorization, so a receipt photographed at the table shows less. All 3 cases (Maya Chen, Sam Rivera, Jordan Ellis) fit: the company card paid the full amount and no one gained. This is a capture-process fix, not a conduct issue.
ruling.quote: In 2017, MasterCard reinstated the use of the 20% tip tolerance to card-not-present (CNP) transactions conducted by U.S. The use of the 20% tip tolerance enables a restaurant merchant to add a tip amount after the authorization was approved.
actions: Correct 3 entries to the card amount (+$50.77 in tips)
One process fix for everyone: photograph the signed copy with the tip, not the itemized receipt
